projects.title: Project N.E.S.A: Spatio-Temporal GNN & EHD Plasma Flight Control
projects.desc: Served as R&D Lead developing a cyber-physical UAV flight control system pairing a PyTorch Geometric dual-headed Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network (50 nodes X 6 features) with high-voltage solid-state DBD plasma actuators. Validated via OpenFOAM and ANSYS CFD sweeps that active electro-fluidic momentum injection yields a 290% retention gain in aerodynamic lift-to-drag (L/D) efficiency across boundaries at 25–40 m/s.

projects.title: Thermodynamic Baffles for Aviation Liquid Hydrogen Tanks
projects.desc: Engineered an internal G-10 CR fiberglass epoxy composite Thermal Dam to decouple mechanical slosh suppression from conductive heat transfer. Developed a 2D Volume of Fluid (VOF) multiphase model with Lee Phase Change mechanics in ANSYS Fluent to simulate take-off kinematics. Layout optimized to reduce transient impact forces by 75% and verified via 1-Way Fluid-Structure Interaction.

projects.title: Hybrid Digital Twin for Aero-Engine Bearing Prognostics
projects.desc: Designed a deep-fusion Hybrid Digital Twin using a Stacked LSTM trained on a dual-path unified loss function embedding the Paris-Erdogan Law to reduce RMSE by 71%. Generated 200,000+ synthetic profiles via Monte Carlo simulation, validated framework via Transfer Learning on NASA IMS dataset, and optimized for an edge latency of 63.26 ms.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Aerodynamic Digital Twin & Physics-Informed Deep Learning
projects.desc: Built an automated aerodynamic optimization pipeline in Python using a Genetic Algorithm and XFOIL viscous solver loop to parameterize an NREL S809 airfoil via Hicks-Henne shape functions. Trained a deep PyTorch MLP to achieve real-time geometric inversion, integrating Savitzky-Golay filtering for numerical stability.

projects.title: Aero-Scribe: Multi-Modal AI Agent for Optimized Aircraft Maintenance
projects.desc: Architected a multi-modal, multi-agent AI system utilizing advanced Large Language Models integrated with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to seamlessly parse and extract actionable insights from high-volume technical documentation and MRO logs. Implemented version control pipelines via GitHub.

projects.title: Compact, Self-Deploying Satellite for Space Debris Collection
projects.desc: Developed a compact, self-deploying satellite architecture for space debris collection using a motorized Aerogel net and autonomous guidance. Integrated microcontrollers, sensors, and mechanical blades to capture debris in LEO, optimized for structural reusability and safe Earth re-entry.

projects.title: Design and Development of All-Terrain Vehicle BAJA SAEINDIA
projects.desc: Collaborated in the design, simulation, fabrication, and testing of a hydrogen-compatible All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV) for the BAJA SAEINDIA H-BAJA competition. Optimized global mechanical, electrical, and thermal architectures for real-world dynamic event tracking.

projects.title: Multi-metal 3D Printing for Complex Components
projects.desc: Developed a multi-metal 3D printing system capable of sequential and parallel deposition of Aluminum 6061, Copper C11000, and AISI 316L Stainless Steel using laser fusion. Integrated thermal monitoring arrays and nickel transition lines to block thermal shock boundaries.

projects.title: Swachh Smart: Smart Highway Amenities Database (NHAI Project)
projects.desc: Conceptualized and built a centralized facility management database layer for the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) using a Python backend and MariaDB. Engineered ingestion pipelines processing live IoT sensor inputs to deliver automated fault detection dashboards.

projects.title: Safe Journeys AI: The Walker App
projects.desc: Designed an AI-powered personal safety network and mobile application transit tracker for students. Engineered predictive models for dynamic route safety scoring and real-time location mapping alongside custom path anomaly detection triggers.

projects.title: Development of Portable Water Sterilization Unit
projects.desc: Designed and fabricated a zero-electricity, portable water sterilization system using friction-generated heat for emergency zones. Integrated multi-stage filtration loops with a copper cylinder friction mechanism drafted inside SolidWorks and verified via CNC physical fabrication.

projects.title: Determining Porosity of Rubber Products
projects.desc: Developed a non-destructive testing method using ultrasonic sensors to detect internal manufacturing porosity inside rubber tires. System generated detailed C-scan visualizations from time-of-flight sensor data to completely replace traditional invasive testing methods.

projects.title: Advanced Pothole Detection and Mitigation System
projects.desc: Designed a real-time tracking network utilizing LiDAR arrays, ultrasonic sensors, and 3D mapping integrated with Google Maps API to provide forward alerts to transit operators 30-40 meters in advance.

projects.title: Advanced Storage Unit for Tomatoes
projects.desc: Designed an IoT-enabled, thermally controlled storage box using UV-C sterilization arrays, smart automated ethylene management filters, and activated charcoal systems to drastically extend agricultural transport life spans.
